Northwind Instruments reports fourth quarter results
PORTLAND, OREGON — Northwind Instruments, Inc. today announced financial results for its fiscal 2026 fourth quarter ended December 28, 2025. The Company posted quarterly revenue of $8.4 billion and quarterly earnings per diluted share of $2.78.
“Instrumentation demand held up through the quarter, and we exited with the cost base we committed to,” said Adaeze Okonjo, Northwind’s Chief Executive Officer.
For the first quarter of fiscal 2027 the Company expects revenue of $8.1 billion to $8.6 billion.
The Company expects non-GAAP diluted earnings per share for the first quarter of fiscal 2027 in a range of $1.94 to $2.11.
